title: CLI fails closed: no silent AWS credential fallback
description: graphql_request_headers (src/papyrus_content/graphql_http.py) signs with the AWS credential chain when no user session file exists and PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH is unset. Make the signed-in user the default: with no session, refuse and say to run papyrus login. IAM only on an explicit opt-in, for workers and the listed break-glass commands. Update the error guidance in operator_errors.py and cli_user_auth.py that tells people to set AWS_PROFILE. Check every worker and scheduled job that relies on the default sets the opt-in before this ships. Gherkin required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #1517 (branch feature/PPY-5f119a-auth-default, prepared 2026-11-14) supersedes closed PR #1057. Audit result: no site repo needs a patch. Papyrus-owned callers declare the operator lane through amplify/site-api-access.ts (connectToSiteApi / siteApiEnvironment add PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam with the endpoint), the CMS staging build spec and break-glass scripts name it, and Machines on Machines already declares it. Consequence for people and agents: any ad hoc role-based command must now name the lane with --auth iam (or PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam); with no session and no lane named the CLI refuses and says to run papyrus login.
